description: Cloud-based customer support software and ticketing platform for managing customer service operations.
auth_notes: Uses personal API keys (passed via HTTP basic auth with username as the API key and 'X' as password) or OAuth 2.0 with specific scopes for public apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial or account and generate an API key directly from their profile settings page.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API v2 covering tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, agents, solutions, time entries, SLAs, and custom objects.
mcp_notes: Freshdesk provides an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration to connect AI tools and apps with helpdesk data.
rationale: Freshdesk offers a broad REST API, self-serve free credential generation via API keys or OAuth2, and an official MCP integration, making it fully ready for agent toolkits.

evidence.note: Details API key authentication methods and OAuth2 scopes.
Explains how developers find and retrieve their API key self-serve in profile settings.
Provides the complete REST API v2 index covering tickets, contacts, companies, etc.
Mentions official Freshdesk MCP integration and connectivity for AI tools.
